sourceSentences: Each Tentacle also heals Illaoi for 5% of her missing health if it hits at least one enemy champion.
Each enemy individually reduces the slam damage by 50% for every slam they were hit by in the last 0.66 seconds, capped at 75% less damage.
Illaoi empowers her next basic attack within 6 seconds to have an uncancellable windup, gain range and cause her to leap to the target's location if they are beyond her normal basic attack range.
Harsh Lesson resets Illaoi's basic attack timer.
Harsh Lesson cannot be cast while Test of Spirit is pulling a Spirit.
The melee attack will still hit if the target becomes untargetable, while the dash attack will not.

When the Spirit is killed or the target leaves tether range, the tether is severed, marking the target as a Vessel for 4 seconds and slowing them by 80% for 1.5 seconds once the tether returns back to them.
For the duration, Harsh Lesson cooldown is halved, all Tentacles awakened by Illaoi are untargetable, will not show their hitboxes, nor go dormant
For each enemy champion hit, a Tentacle is summoned for 8 seconds (up to a maximum of 6 summons).
Each tentacle also heals Illaoi for chunk of her missing health if it hits at least one enemy champion.
When the spirit is killed or the target leaves its tether range, they become slowed and also start spawning tentacles around them, which keep attacking them.
For each enemy champion hit or spirit from her E, she summons a tentacle.
All the tentacles she summons to her ultimate can't be killed, and her W has half the cooldown.
For combos, your basic go-to is to start with E into an attack and follow up with W into Q, before following up with more attacks and W's while the target is slowed.
And your all-in is slam E into your ultimate, attack into W before attacking into Q, and then with the lower cooldown on W, just keep spamming away with attacks and W's.
The first combo is the auto W combo. This is a very basic combo and I always highly recommend you auto attack first so you can deal more damage.
The second combo is the auto WQ combo.
The third combo is E auto WQ combo.
The fourth combo is the ER auto WQ combo. If you plan on using your ultimate, always make sure you hit your E on your opponent first to increase the amounts of tentacles that can spawn.
If the spirit gets killed or the target runs out too far out of range, the target will become a vessel. He'll get slowed and tentacles begin to spawn around the target.
